project_type: Python FastAPI Enterprise Document Management System with async SQLAlchemy, ChromaDB vector search, LLM integration
build_system: uv package manager, no Makefile or build scripts currently exist
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, asyncio_mode=auto, tests in /tests/ directory, uses httpx AsyncClient with ASGITransport
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'uv sync' to install deps. 2. Run 'uv run ruff check app/ tests/' for lint. 3. Run 'uv run pytest tests/ -x -q' to confirm tests pass.
setup_instructions: uv sync installs all dependencies into .venv
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Docker daemon available for build testing.
contribution_requirements: Use ruff for linting, pytest-asyncio for tests, follow existing patterns in app/api/ and app/services/

key_patterns.models: All models inherit from Base in app/models/group.py, imported in app/models/__init__.py
key_patterns.config: pydantic-settings in app/core/config.py with Settings class, env_file='.env'
key_patterns.database: Async SQLAlchemy with create_async_engine in app/core/database.py, DATABASE_URL defaults to sqlite+aiosqlite
key_patterns.middleware: Starlette BaseHTTPMiddleware pattern, RequestIDMiddleware adds X-Request-ID header and request.state.request_id
key_patterns.api_routes: Each file in app/api/ exports a 'router' APIRouter, registered in app/api/router.py
key_patterns.background_tasks: Currently uses FastAPI BackgroundTasks in app/api/documents.py, app/api/settings_backup.py, app/services/bulk.py
key_patterns.services: Service classes in app/services/, instantiated per-endpoint or as module-level singletons
key_patterns.tests: Tests in tests/ directory, use db_session and client fixtures from conftest.py, SQLite in-memory

directory_structure: app/ (main application), app/api/ (60+ route files), app/core/ (config, database, security, llm), app/middleware/ (error_handler, rate_limiter, geofence, tenant), app/models/ (35+ model files), app/services/ (50+ service files), tests/ (test files), wiki/ (LLM wiki content), storage/ (uploaded files)
